trips_dates_ck.name: trips_dates_ck
trips_dates_ck.value: "trips"."end_date" is null or "trips"."start_date" is null or "trips"."end_date" >= "trips"."start_date"

components_cost_ck.name: components_cost_ck
components_cost_ck.value: ("itinerary_components"."unit_cost" is null or "itinerary_components"."unit_cost" >= 0) and ("itinerary_components"."quantity" is null or "itinerary_components"."quantity" >= 0) and ("itinerary_components"."actual_cost" is null or "itinerary_components"."actual_cost" >= 0)

components_cost_currency_ck.name: components_cost_currency_ck
components_cost_currency_ck.value: "itinerary_components"."unit_cost" is null or "itinerary_components"."cost_currency" is not null

alloc_mileage_ck.name: alloc_mileage_ck
alloc_mileage_ck.value: "vehicle_allocations"."mileage_in" is null or "vehicle_allocations"."mileage_out" is null or "vehicle_allocations"."mileage_in" >= "vehicle_allocations"."mileage_out"

defects_resolution_ck.name: defects_resolution_ck
defects_resolution_ck.value: "vehicle_defects"."resolved_at" is null or "vehicle_defects"."resolution" is not null

movements_trip_ck.name: movements_trip_ck
movements_trip_ck.value: "inventory_movements"."type" not in ('reserve','release','issue','return','lost') or "inventory_movements"."trip_id" is not null
